info.title: AI use case assessment (lab)
info.description: Submit an AI use case for assessment, find one somebody already submitted, follow a run to its outcome, and answer the questions the assessment raises. Every operation goes through the lab's governed gateway, which meters it, traces it and enforces what this connection is granted.

post.description: The governed tool surface: use_case_screening_submit, _status, _result, _runs (find a past use case), and the approval gate (approvals_list, approvals_get, approvals_decide). Which of them this connection may call is decided by the key, not by this file. Streamable HTTP: the caller must accept BOTH application/json and text/event-stream, which is what `produces` declares — a client that accepts only JSON is refused with 406 before it reaches a tool.

default.description: The MCP stream. Shaped by the protocol, not by this file.

parameters.name: Accept
parameters.description: Streamable HTTP requires BOTH media types. Declared as a parameter with a default rather than left to `produces`: the Power Platform runtime does not derive the Accept header from `produces`, and a client that accepts only JSON is refused with 406 before it reaches a tool.

api_key.name: Authorization
api_key.description: Bearer <USECASE_SUBMITTER_KEY> — the virtual key of the `usecase-submitter` team. Type it when you create the connection; it is never stored in this file.
